Summary:
This work is a sequel to the previous title
“~Who Cares About the Age Difference~ Part 1 The Wife Next Door (35)."

You can still enjoy this work on its own even if you haven’t read the previous one, but reading the earlier story first will make this one more enjoyable.

***

I fell in love with Erina Kitakouji, the woman who moved in next door, even though I knew my feelings could never come true while I was still just a student.

Ten years have gone by since then.

When I saw her again, she was standing behind the counter of a small shop, wearing the same bright smile she had back then.

"No one hits on a 45-year-old woman who has her own store."

"I'm an old lady now, so I'm not at an age where I should be playing with fire."

I, once a student, had become a working adult.

And Erina Kitakoji, once known as the "woman next door," had gone from being someone’s wife to just being a woman on her own.
My confession was dismissed as nothing—age, social status, reality.
The confession I’d held onto for nine years was shattered in an instant.
Even so, I couldn’t forget. That voice, that night, that smile.
So I kept chasing after Erina-san every day. And then...

"Don't say I didn't warn you... You're stirring up a woman this old...!!"

"I won't forgive you if you're not serious about this ♡."
